settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Defaults for every item. An item can override the hooks.
settings.hooks_hint: Home Assistant scripts to call when an item finishes.
settings.hook_warning: When a run finishes with a warning
settings.overdue: Warn when a backup is overdue
settings.overdue_hint: An item needs attention when a scheduled run is more than this many days late.
settings.keep_hint: Older runs and their logs are removed from the add-on. Your backups are not touched.
settings.time_zone_hint: Follows Home Assistant. Schedules and times in the log use it.
settings.logging_hint: Logs stay inside the add-on. They are shown on the run pages and nowhere else.
settings.config_hint: Items and targets are stored here. You can also edit it by hand.
settings.types_hint: Add your own type as a folder in types/ next to the config file, then refresh.
settings.private_text: HomeBackup only talks to the Home Assistant Supervisor. It sends no telemetry and makes no outside requests.
settings.applies: Changes apply to the next run.
